description: Physics-lumped (0D) dual-fluidised-bed calcium looping. Carbonator (650C, exothermic) CaO+CO2->CaCO3 captures CO2; calciner (900C, endothermic) CaCO3->CaO+CO2 regenerates sorbent and yields a concentrated CO2 stream. Sorbent maximum carrying capacity decays with cycle number (Grasa & Abanades 2006). Coupled molar inventory + energy-balance ODE integrated with scipy.solve_ivp.

unit.name: Generic limestone-derived CaO dual-bed calcium looping system
unit.source: Abanades (2002) Chem. Eng. J. 90:303; Abanades et al. (2004) AIChE J. 50(7):1614; Grasa & Abanades (2006) Ind. Eng. Chem. Res. 45:8846; Blamey et al. (2010) Prog. Energy Combust. Sci. 36:260; Dean et al. (2011) Chem. Eng. Res. Des. 89:836

X_max1.note: Grasa-Abanades a-factor: fresh-sorbent maximum conversion fast-stage limit; X_N -> X_r as N->inf

k_deact.note: Grasa-Abanades deactivation constant k for CaO from limestone (650C, 0.01 atm CO2)

X_r.note: Residual (asymptotic) carrying capacity after many cycles

k_s_carb.note: Lumped first-order fast-stage carbonation rate constant toward X_N

T_carbonator_C.note: Carbonation favoured below ~700C at flue-gas pCO2

T_calciner_C.note: Calcination above equilibrium T at 1 atm CO2 (~895C)

dH_carb_kJ_mol.note: Exothermic carbonation enthalpy CaO+CO2->CaCO3 at 298K; calcination is +178

cp_solid_J_molK.note: Mean molar heat capacity of CaO/CaCO3 solids inventory

F_CaO_mol_s.note: Circulating molar flow of CaO (sorbent looping rate) between beds

F_CO2_in_mol_s.note: CO2 molar flow entering carbonator with the flue gas

F_makeup_mol_s.note: Fresh limestone make-up to offset deactivation and purge

N_inventory_mol.note: Total solids molar inventory in carbonator (lumped)

hA_carb_W_K.note: Lumped heat-removal/exchange coefficient for carbonator thermal balance
